name: sheet-worker

bundle.note: The engine wasm is an upload part, not bundled: Workers compile wasm only at upload, so it arrives as a CompiledWasm module. `assets` makes the bundle manifest hash its bytes (bundler R4), so a different engine under the same source is stale. One build input is another tree's: ../bio-plane/src/cpu.mjs (runtime-limits' makeMeter). The wasm itself is built from engine/ by scripts/build-engine.mjs and committed (PROCESS-MECHANICS §14).

note: The fleet-member marker, found by bundler's discoverMembers. The suite (test/) boots the committed bundle under miniflare, a devDependency, so `npm test` needs `npm ci` here first.
